malformed_return.recovery: find the error with: python3 -m json.tool RETURN.json; then run import-preview again

packet_altered.recovery: export a new packet: python3 -B -m flh_extraction.exchange export --work DIR --practice-id P --out NEW.json

packet_v0.recovery: export a new packet: python3 -B -m flh_extraction.exchange export --work DIR --practice-id P --out NEW.json

return_for_another_packet.recovery: preview it with the packet it names: python3 -B -m flh_extraction.exchange import-preview --context THAT_PACKET.json --return RETURN.json

return_v2.recovery: ask the agent to write the return with the template at the end of the packet's Markdown, then run: python3 -B -m flh_extraction.exchange import-preview --context CONTEXT.json --return RETURN.json
